_fixture_notes.description: Sanitized fixture documenting the Satchel One OAuth2 password-grant login, captured from a live browser session 2026-06-05. All ids, tokens, emails and names are fake. Structure mirrors the live request/response field-for-field.

request.note: endpoint is at the domain ROOT, not under /api

query_params.client_id: <web client id — baked into Satchel's public frontend>
query_params.client_secret: <web client secret — baked into Satchel's public frontend>

request.note_body: no school_id, no verification_token — the live web client sends only these three fields

_fixture_notes.response_note: access_token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (plus `X-Platform: web`) on every subsequent /api call. Refresh uses the SAME /oauth/token endpoint with a non-standard body: grant_type + smhw_token (Satchel uses the smhw_token field, not refresh_token, for renewal).
